mapper.insert: INSERT INTO challenge ( owner_id, name, challenge_type, invite_code, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{ownerId}, #{name}, #{challengeType}, #{inviteCode}, #{status}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_id, name, challenge_type, invite_code, status, created_at FROM challenge WHERE id = #{challengeId}
SELECT id, owner_id, name, challenge_type, invite_code, status, created_at FROM challenge WHERE invite_code = #{inviteCode}

SELECT challenge_id, user_id, week_start_date, rank_position, nickname, profile_image_url, saving_amount, streak_days, like_count, reward_point FROM V_WEEKLY_RANKING WHERE challenge_id = #{challengeId} ORDER BY rank_position, user_id

SELECT users.id AS user_id, users.nickname, users.profile_image_url, DATE(users.created_at) AS joined_at, users.streak_days, users.current_challenge_id, challenge.name AS current_challenge_name, COALESCE(feed_stats.total_saving_amount, 0) AS total_saving_amount, COALESCE(feed_stats.current_month_saving_amount, 0) AS current_month_saving_amount, COALESCE(feed_stats.previous_month_saving_amount, 0) AS previous_month_saving_amount, CASE WHEN COALESCE(feed_stats.previous_month_saving_amount, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( (feed_stats.current_month_saving_amount - feed_stats.previous_month_saving_amount) * 100.0 / feed_stats.previous_month_saving_amount, 1 ) END AS saving_change_rate, COALESCE(feed_stats.verification_count, 0) AS verification_count, COALESCE(feed_stats.average_saving_amount, 0) AS average_saving_amount, COALESCE(feed_stats.post_count, 0) AS post_count, COALESCE(feed_stats.received_like_count, 0) AS received_like_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE message.user_id = users.id AND message.message_type = 'REPLY' ) AS comment_count FROM users LEFT JOIN challenge ON challenge.id = users.current_challenge_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT feed.user_id, SUM(feed.saving_amount) AS total_saving_amount, SUM( CASE WHEN feed.created_at >= CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AND feed.created_at < DATE_ADD( CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE), INTERVAL 1 MONTH ) THEN feed.saving_amount ELSE 0 END ) AS current_month_saving_amount, SUM( CASE WHEN feed.created_at >= DATE_SUB( CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE), INTERVAL 1 MONTH ) AND feed.created_at < CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) THEN feed.saving_amount ELSE 0 END ) AS previous_month_saving_amount, COUNT(*) AS verification_count, ROUND(AVG(feed.saving_amount), 0) AS average_saving_amount, COUNT(*) AS post_count, SUM(feed.like_count) AS received_like_count FROM feed WHERE feed.status = 'ACTIVE' AND feed.file_deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY feed.user_id ) feed_stats ON feed_stats.user_id = users.id WHERE users.id = #{userId}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(months.month_start, '%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(feed.saving_amount), 0) AS saving_amount FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(current_month.month_start, INTERVAL 5 MONTH) AS month_start FROM ( SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month_start ) current_month UNION ALL SELECT DATE_SUB(current_month.month_start, INTERVAL 4 MONTH) FROM ( SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month_start ) current_month UNION ALL SELECT DATE_SUB(current_month.month_start, INTERVAL 3 MONTH) FROM ( SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month_start ) current_month UNION ALL SELECT DATE_SUB(current_month.month_start, INTERVAL 2 MONTH) FROM ( SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month_start ) current_month UNION ALL SELECT DATE_SUB(current_month.month_start, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) FROM ( SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month_start ) current_month UNION ALL SELECT current_month.month_start FROM ( SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month_start ) current_month ) months LEFT JOIN feed ON feed.user_id = #{userId} AND feed.status = 'ACTIVE' AND feed.file_deleted_at IS NULL AND feed.created_at >= months.month_start AND feed.created_at < DATE_ADD(months.month_start, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY months.month_start ORDER BY months.month_start

SELECT feed.id AS feed_id, feed.challenge_id, feed.caption, feed.thumbnail_url, feed.media_url, feed.like_count, feed.created_at FROM feed WHERE feed.user_id = #{userId} AND feed.status = 'ACTIVE' AND feed.file_deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY feed.like_count DESC, feed.created_at DESC, feed.id LIMIT 3
